Third-party license and copyright notices for the moNa2 firmware distribution

This inventory conservatively includes all 250 packages resolved for the ARM
firmware target, including host build-time dependencies that may not be linked
into the UF2. Listing a license does not apply it to unrelated components.
Original license/attribution texts follow. Dual-license alternatives are retained;
btuuid and const-gen-derive use the expressly offered Apache-2.0 option, with
published metadata/attribution retained where no license file was packaged.
Nordic binary libraries retain their Nordic-only-use conditions. Rust standard
library notices are supplied separately in licenses/RUST-STANDARD-LIBRARY.html.

# btuuid

Rust types for Bluetooth UUID values, including 16-, 32- and 128-bit UUIDs.

Also includes constants for many Bluetooth SIG defined 16-bit UUIDs.

--- README-LICENSE.txt ---
Source: published nrf-pac crate

# nrf-pac

This is a [Peripheral Access Crate](https://rust-embedded.github.io/book/start/registers.html) for Nordic Semiconductor nRF microcontrollers.

This crate has been automatically generated from the SVD files in [nrfx](https://github.com/NordicSemiconductor/nrfx), using [chiptool](https://github.com/embassy-rs/chiptool/). Fixes are added to the SVD file to make the
crate more amenable to writing HALs with, such as converting sets of identical registers/fields to arrays, merging identical registers and enums, etc.

This crate is used for the [`embassy-nrf`](https://github.com/embassy-rs/embassy/tree/main/embassy-nrf) Rust Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) for the nRF microcontrollers.

## Supported chips


- nRF51xx
- nRF52805
- nRF52810
- nRF52811
- nRF52820
- nRF52832
- nRF52833
- nRF52840
- nRF5340 appplication core
- nRF5340 network core
- nRF54L15 appplication core
- nRF9120 (SoC used in nRF9131, nRF9161 and nRF9151)
- nRF9160

## License

The contents of this crate are auto-generated and licensed under the same terms as the underlying SVD file, which is licensed by Nordic Semiconductor under a BSD-3-Clause license.
